reason: OpenRouter already works for me and the 5.5% fee is noise next to my budget. I might grab the free 50k credit to poke at it, but I'm not moving production traffic or prepaid money to a brand-new one-person gateway.
objection: A new one-person company could disappear with my prepaid balance, and if it goes down my product goes down with it.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of public uptime history and other Vietnamese teams running production on it, plus the VAT invoice becoming something my accountant actually needs.
